summary: Tested everything in the iteration-35 request. Backend: added a new pytest file with 11 tests and all 11 pass. They cover plain-answer CTF submission (SOCF{3389} is wrong, 3389 is right), rejection of SOCF{...} flags in /manage/ctfs (422 with the correct message), the AI CTF draft job (done in about 15s, plain answer, no SOCF anywhere), staff-only guards, and the Google-only flow for /auth/set-password and /auth/change-password (400 in both wrong-mode cases, weak-password rejection, cookies re-issued, login with the new password) plus /auth/forgot-password. Frontend checked with Playwright, everything passed: (1) sticky path-tab-header shows the title and all 5 tabs and stays at y=0 after scrolling. Each tab renders inside the path: 12 quiz cards, SOP grid with working search, ctf-board, threat-intel-page with intel-input. Lesson completion works (0% to 25%). (2) In /app/ctf and the CTF tab there is no SOCF text, the placeholder reads 'Your answer', and the unlocked hint is clean. SOCF{3389} gives 'Wrong flag'; 3389 gives 'Flag captured! +80'. (3) Admin Path Builder: New CTF opens ctf-creator with all fields and the default flag is empty. SOCF{a} shows the error toast. AI draft filled the form with a plain IP answer. Saving shows a toast, the CTF lands in the db as published, and it appears as builder-attachment-0. Instructor flow: a hand-made CTF stayed attached in the saved path's lesson attachments. (4) Instructor content editor's new CTF has flag "". (5) Account: a normal user sees google 'not linked' / password 'linked' and change-password-card. A Google-only user sees google 'linked' / password 'not set' and set-password-card with no current-password field; the email-link button and setting the password both work, and the page switches to the change card and stays that way after reload. Google button is still present on the login page. No SOCF is left in the db ctfs (flags, descriptions or hints).

minor.issue: A Google-only user who asks for a set-password link gets the generic 'Reset your SOCProfessionals Academy password' email ('We received a request to reset your password'). The wording does not fit someone who has never had a password.
Answers are compared case-insensitively, so they are not fully strict. This is fine for ports and IPs; SOCF{x} is correctly rejected.

issues: The form grid has 3 columns but only 2 inputs in set mode, so the Set password button wraps to the next row, out of line with the inputs. Minor.

The Quizzes and SOPs tabs list every quiz and SOP on the platform rather than only those in this path. SOPs in the path are tagged 'in this path' and sorted first; quizzes have no such filter. Acceptable, but consider marking quizzes that belong to the path.

routes_manage validation only blocks the 'SOCF{' prefix; other wrappers such as FLAG{x} typed by hand are still accepted (the AI parse_ctf removes any wrapper)
Leftover ctf_solves from earlier test users whose accounts were deleted still show on the live scoreboard as 'TEST User'
